name: What types of accessibility and mobility modifications can be incorporated into an interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: What types of accessibility and mobility modifications can be incorporated into an interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accessibility modifications are practical renovations that improve safety, mobility, and ease of use for residents of all ages. Common projects include widening doorways through structural framing adjustments, eliminating threshold steps, installing curbless roll-in showers with slip-resistant tile, and adding reinforced backing inside drywall for sturdy grab bars. Other frequent upgrades include lowering light switches, raising electrical outlets, and converting kitchen cabinetry to accessible pull-out drawers. Planning these changes during a broader interior remodel saves money by addressing framing and wall reinforcements before finish drywall and tile are installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accessibility options include wider doorways, curbless walk-in showers, reinforced drywall grab-bar backing, zero-threshold flooring, and lower-reach storage.
